idea-plugin.name: Teal
idea-plugin.description:
Teal (.tl) support for IntelliJ IDEA: syntax highlighting, inline diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition (including from a require string to the module's file), Find Usages (same-document), and a quick fix that adds the missing require for an unknown global type.

A thin companion plugin — nearly all language intelligence is delegated to LSP4IJ wrapping teal-language-server, which must be installed separately (luarocks install teal-language-server). The exceptions are Find Usages, the missing-require quick fix, and go-to-definition on a require string: teal-language-server doesn't implement textDocument/references or textDocument/codeAction, and only resolves definitions of identifiers, so the plugin answers those itself. Syntax highlighting reuses vscode-teal's MIT-licensed TextMate grammar.

server.name: Teal Language Server
server.description: Wraps teal-language-server to provide diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, Find Usages, and quick fixes for Teal (.tl) files.
